# X6 R11 — two mobile triads: exact relative-collision cone and future-language compression

Date: 2026-11-19 (Asia/Shanghai). Research line RS-X6-NATIVE-TIME-DYNAMICS; immutable publication TP2-91D4A7C2F63805BE21A3. Author-side conditional exact theorem; independent review NOT_REVIEWED. Original scientific input is frozen at awdawmip/enterprise-math@a72226e2430ffa4786321ac86e7f0c599d5f0389 (P000 V5 / Viète phase-refinement separation / half-turn root lineage), while current behavioral rules are read separately. Prior R10: [repeated Port obstacle-frontier theorem](2026-11-19_x6_repeated_port_visibility_frontier_r10.md). Researcher line: EM-X6-214D9C, SID MCP-d467c19ce42d4d7fa65a3901db1cf6b2, Activity RA-545183ADD4EF71C3E4698AEE; a live formal writer requires its own current authorization.

## Problem and precise conditional event carrier

R10 allowed one labelled triad B to move repeatedly while other occupied triads remained fixed. Here **two separate labelled triads A and B can both move**. Fix a chosen X6 native Cell chart, with six signed relative integer coordinates (no distinguished global Cell origin); choose two nonempty fixed positive native-axis Port sets I_A,I_B contained in {0,...,5}. The two distinct current occupied Cells are a,b in Z^6, with relative displacement d=b-a !=0. The full typed state also retains source IDs, internal triad tokens, the occupied-cell relation and prior branch provenance.

A proposed event (A,i) for i in I_A translates A one native unit e_i; (B,i) for i in I_B translates B by e_i. The event is legal exactly when its target Cell is vacant. The moved triad vacates its previous Cell; no other obstacles, terminal quotas, hidden Port controller or clock-time dynamics occur in this **declared vacancy-only submodel**. The event is one positive native-axis primitive step, not a diagonal. Triadic tokens are only assumed to remain available; actual force closure TRIADIC_CLOSURE_E is not established by this model.

The Boolean-BRC support carrier retains the entire ordered branch set of source/Port-labelled words and joint states, with guarded append. The observer knows I_A,I_B,h and source/count phase information shared by a candidate fiber, but hides relative displacement d. Its required readout L_h(d) is the complete prefix-closed language of legal words of length <=h. Every legal labelled next event is available. Event-step count h is separate from physical duration, C6/C12 phase and precision refinement.

## Theorem A. Reachable collision cone and exact first blocked step

Write S=I_A intersection I_B, U=I_A minus I_B and V=I_B minus I_A. Set

    K={d in Z^6\{0}: d_i=0 for i outside I_A union I_B,
       d_i>=0 for i in U, d_i<=0 for i in V,
       d_i arbitrary integer for i in S}.

If d is outside K, every finite word is legal and no attempted collision occurs. If d belongs to K, the **first possible blocked attempted event** is at exactly r(d)=sum_i |d_i|, and there is a constructive blocked word w_d of length r(d): for each positive d_i append d_i copies of (A,i); for each negative d_i append -d_i copies of (B,i). Order these events arbitrarily.

Proof: a move of A changes d to d-e_i, a move of B changes it to d+e_i. The proposed move is blocked iff the resulting d would be zero. Off-frame nonzero displacements never change; A-only coordinates cannot increase and B-only coordinates cannot decrease, so a wrong-signed component cannot reach zero. For a vector in K the displayed word decreases its L1 norm by exactly one at each step; every proper prefix has a nonzero displacement and hence is legal, whereas the final attempted event is blocked. Any sequence of fewer than r(d) unit changes cannot reduce the L1 norm to zero. QED.

A near Cell is not necessarily detectable: with I_A={0}, I_B={1}, displacement d=(0,1,0,0,0,0) is invisible for every horizon, whereas d=(2,-3,0,0,0,0) is first collision-detectable at event 5.

## Theorem B. Exact finite-horizon equivalence and information-theoretic optimum

Define a horizon-dependent signature for all d!=0:

    sigma_h(d) = d      if d in K and ||d||_1<=h;
                 FAR    otherwise.

For every d,d' !=0 and every h>=0,

    L_h(d)=L_h(d')  iff  sigma_h(d)=sigma_h(d').

Proof: every FAR vector has no collision within h steps by Theorem A, hence its language consists of *all* decorated Port words up to h. For a visible d, w_d is blocked at r(d)<=h, distinguishing it from FAR. For visible d !=d' with r(d)<r(d'), w_d is absent under d but legal under d' through that shorter length. When radii coincide, no proper prefix of w_d can collide in either configuration; its total relative-coordinate change equals -d, so its final event is blocked for d but remains legal for d' !=d. The other ordering of unequal radii is symmetric. Thus different signatures give different full languages, and the same signature gives equal full languages. QED.

A sharper conclusion: for two distinguishable relative states the minimum length of a word separating their languages is the smaller finite collision depth, with depth infinity for an unreachable collision cone. Each observable fiber C of candidate hidden displacements therefore has the precise worst-case additional storage cost

    bits_h(C) = ceil(log_2 |{sigma_h(d): d in C}|).

This is attained by indexing the signature classes. It is an *observer-typed minimal memory* statement. An observer already given both full Cell positions knows d and needs no additional bits for this particular distinction.

## Theorem C. Closed-form class count and future-safe Markov update

Let s=|I_A intersection I_B| and m=|I_A union I_B|>=1. On the unrestricted six-coordinate relative Cell torsor the class count is

    N_h = 1 + sum_{r=1}^h [x^r] (1+x)^s/(1-x)^m
        = 1 + sum_{r=1}^h sum_{j=0}^{min(s,r)}
                       C(s,j) C(r-j+m-1,m-1).

The leading 1 is the pooled FAR class (there are always nonzero off-active-axis offsets in the ambient X6 setting, since each triad uses at most three Ports in the tested case). Each shared axis contributes 1+2x+2x^2+...=(1+x)/(1-x), while each one-sided axis contributes 1+x+x^2+...=1/(1-x); multiply over independent signed coordinate displacements, remove the zero configuration and add the FAR class. The formula also works when all six axes are active: arbitrarily large displacements supply FAR for any finite h.

For I_A=I_B={0,1,2}, the exact N_h for h=0,1,2,3,4,5,6 is 1,7,25,63,129,231,377; the corresponding minimal unrestricted-fiber bits are 0,3,5,6,8,8,9. This selects three axes *inside* X6; it does not posit a native two-dimensional plane or reduce the six native spatial dimensions. For I_A={0}, I_B={1}, the count simplifies to N_h=1+h(h+3)/2.

The quotient is **future-safe**. Given the signature sigma_h(d) and a proposed labelled move, decide legality and compute sigma_(h-1)(d_new): if visible, use the stored d and exact +/- unit update, reject d_new=0, and reclassify at h-1. From FAR all first events are legal and the next state is still FAR: a displacement outside K remains outside K under the allowed signs; if d in K and ||d||_1>h, a unit step leaves ||d_new||_1>h-1. Therefore induction on horizon preserves every future branch language, not just the immediate availability readout. The unbounded-horizon quotient has singleton classes for each d in K and a single class for all d outside K; its visible class set is countably infinite in unbounded X6, with no finite uniform bit ceiling.

## Exact computation, scope and reproducibility

Two independent representations were compared: (1) actual exhaustive Boolean-BRC support of all legal *ordered* source/Port-labelled words; (2) predicted collision-cone vector signature and generating-function count. The executable test covers all 49 ordered pairs of nonempty Port masks on native axes 0,1,2, all signed relative displacements with first three components in [-3,3] except zero, plus an off-frame nonzero displacement, and horizons h=0..3. It verifies **both directions** of language/signature equality by dictionary bijections, shortest missing-word witnesses, every legal first-event language derivative (future safety), and exact class counts. The complete result is PASS for **67,228 state×horizon instances, 1,986 class correspondences and 172,368 derivative checks**. Additional probes show a depth-3 mixed-sign witness, permanent one-sided invisibility, a depth-5 witness and off-frame invisibility. Arbitrary-horizon conclusions are proved above; finite tests serve as separate executable checks.

- [Source/Port-labelled exact Boolean-BRC checker](https://github.com/awdawmip/enterprise-math/blob/b59491589f5ee8a019515d1e377f4e753c9b0068/research_notes/portable_direct/x6_two_mobile_port_relative_future_brc_verify.py), observed Git blob 98c8651b543036727f6067a41755f69d5ee7c3b6.
- [Exact JSON result](https://github.com/awdawmip/enterprise-math/blob/1022d3d4a7c5f398adea4fa9632e3a7cbbba69c6/research_notes/portable_direct/x6_two_mobile_port_relative_future_brc_results.json), observed Git blob def0144c8cb0ec00025522b546446ccd33bd91f6.

Reproduce with: python3 x6_two_mobile_port_relative_future_brc_verify.py. Arithmetic consists of signed integers, finite exact sets and binomial coefficients. Boolean support is existence of fully labelled branches, not a signed-amplitude or physical-force surrogate.

## Relation to P000 and next scientific discriminator

R11 extends the R10 *conditional* moving-Port problem from one mobile triad and frozen obstacles to two mobile triads, giving a sharp collision accessibility cone, a first-observation distance and a minimal sufficient horizon-graded Markov signature. It does not assert that arbitrary Port moves satisfy native TRIADIC_CLOSURE_E, and it has not received independent mathematical review, formal Result or Foundation promotion.

The next useful question is compositionality for **three mutually mobile source-labelled triads**. Do independent pairwise horizon quotients preserve all joint collision guards? Test a minimum three-source witness: a third source may occupy an A target even when B's pairwise future sees no collision. Seek an exact joint-source occupancy/Port signature and its smallest counterexample to pairwise factorization. Only then connect the declared guards to the genuinely admitted TRIADIC_CLOSURE_E and triadic force update rules. The event trace remains the separate time-order coordinate, not a seventh spatial direction.
